confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates for Mendoza in July 2026 (austral winter, with mid-year school holidays), not checked against live menus, listings or booking pages. Argentine peso-denominated prices move sharply with inflation and the exchange rate, so USD equivalents are especially uncertain. Restaurant and café anchors are somewhat more reliable than accommodation. Cocktail and wine_glass were set from the local beer and wine price relationship (Mendoza is a wine region, so wine is comparatively cheap), not from direct price knowledge. The FX observation (0.6955 as at 15 October 2026) was taken from search-result summaries that attribute it to the RBA exchange rates page; I could not open that page to confirm the figure directly. A 16 October figure of 0.6947 from a third-party site was not used.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against mid-sized Argentine tourist and wine-region cities and other Latin American cities with comparable domestic-tourism price levels, adjusted for Mendoza's winter season and its reputation as a wine destination.
